entities.summary: Marta Helena Nobel-Oleinikoff, née Marta Helena Nobel, was a Russian-Swedish physician and philanthropist and member of the Nobel family. She was the daughter of industrialist and humanitarian Ludvig Nobel and the niece of Alfred Nobel.
